title: AttestationClaim (illustrative, ENISA SbD&D §5.4 Figure 5)
description: DERIVED from the field names of Figure 5. ENISA states the field names and structure 'are illustrative only and do not define a specific schema or implementation format' (§5.4.2.3). Layers: control (principle, threat_id), implementation (mitigation_control, secure_by_default_setting), assessment and verification (verification_gate).

threat_id.description: threat scenario ids from the threat model (control layer)

secure_by_default_setting.description: technical settings instantiating the control (implementation layer); open content
